Please solve this issue: You are fixing a Minecraft-parity bug in the Pumpkin server (Rust, target MC 26.2). Work only inside this repo.

Bug B1: Block states rejected in setblock and clone filtered
Files: `pumpkin/src/command/argument_types/block.rs`, `pumpkin/src/command/args/block.rs`
What is wrong: `minecraft:wheat[age=0]` is rejected by both parsers. The newer one stops consuming at `[`; the legacy one hands the whole token to `Block::from_name`.
Verified vanilla behaviour: 
The change to make: Both have `Item = &'static Block` and consumers use `block.default_state.id`. Real support means changing the argument's item type to a resolved block state and threading it through `setblock`, `fill`, `clone` and `execute if block`.
Be careful: This is a type change across four commands, not a parser tweak.

Make the smallest change that fixes exactly this. Do not touch unrelated code. When done, run `cargo build -p pumpkin` and make sure it compiles, then stop. Do not commit.

You can execute bash commands and edit files to implement the necessary changes.
